item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Clear Selected Desk Clutter

turns.text: Remove the papers and the empty takeaway cup from this desk photo. Leave the laptop, coffee mug and cables alone.

item.tests: Tests selective clutter removal without deleting nearby objects the user explicitly wants retained.

answer_sheet.Objects to remove: The papers and the empty takeaway cup only.
answer_sheet.Objects to keep: Keep the laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables in their original positions.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Natural photo edit, original wide framing, free-tier resolution.

must_haves: The papers and empty takeaway cup are absent.
The laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables remain visibly intact in their original positions.
Exposed desk areas have believable surface texture and lighting, without leftover object fragments.
The original wide framing and surrounding home-office scene are preserved.

turns.text: Remove the papers and the empty takeaway cup from this desk pic. Leave the laptop, coffee mug and cables alone. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started an edit or spent any generation credits.**

The cheapest listed option is **Flux 2 Klein, one image at 640px**, available on your free plan. Its listed price **starts at 5 credits per image**. I can’t verify an exact account-specific charge or your balance with the tools available, so that’s an estimate—not a guaranteed quote.

For this edit, I’d remove the loose papers and empty takeaway cup on the right, preserving the laptop, ceramic coffee mug, cables, lighting and framing as closely as possible.

**Cheaper or smaller?**
- 640px is the smallest listed output setting; your original is already about 512px wide.
- One output and one attempt avoids paying for multiple variations.
- “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still photo.
- A manual clone/heal editor would use **zero Magic Hour credits**.

Would you like to proceed with the **estimated 5-credit option**, or would you prefer instructions for a free manual edit?

turns.agent:
The edit was blocked because your account has **insufficient credits**. No image was generated.

I won’t retry or start another paid job. For a zero-credit alternative, you can use a free clone/heal editor to remove the papers and takeaway cup while leaving the laptop, mug and cables intact.
